bugs_found: compound_interest uses multiplication by (n * years) instead of exponentiation, so it does not compute principal * (1 + rate/n)^(n*years).
compound_interest returns 0 when years == 0 with principal > 0, violating M = principal and M >= principal.
compound_interest returns principal * n * years when annual_rate == 0, violating M = principal for zero rate.
